result.summary: Found 2 notable issues: a broken/missing image in the 'Popular right now' section and a truncated restaurant card at the right edge.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken-image placeholder icon instead of the restaurant's photo, leaving a large empty gray area in the 'Popular right now' section.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or add a fallback placeholder image/restaurant logo so the card doesn't render as an empty gray block.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge, with its name and image truncated.
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional horizontal scrolling, but consider adding a visual affordance (e.g., partial peek with clearer spacing or a scroll indicator) so users know more cards are available.
